name: Medusa
summary: Open-source commerce platform and framework for building custom e-commerce applications.
description: Commerce backend with core modules and a customisation framework for B2B or DTC stores, marketplaces, distributor platforms, PoS systems and service businesses. Core commerce modules are open source and published on npm; you can start on the managed Medusa Cloud or self-host an application following the documentation.
contains: core commerce modules open source and freely available on npm
supports B2B/DTC stores, marketplaces, distributor platforms, PoS systems and service businesses
managed Medusa Cloud with automated deployments, scaling and maintenance
open-core: MIT-licensed core, RBAC Enterprise Edition under a commercial agreement
